title: Templars as keepers of advanced knowledge and a bloodline of Christ

tellings.quote: because because I do think that the Templars were custodians of of advanced knowledge and they were also supposed to have you know protected maybe a a bloodline of Christ.

plain: The Knights Templar, the medieval order of crusading knights, held some kind of advanced knowledge and may also have protected a bloodline descended from Christ. That is the view of a researcher named Randall Carlson, who tells it to Michels as his own belief, without naming a source, and mentions the Templar figure Jacques de Molay along the way. If it were true, a lost body of knowledge would have been handed down in secret through the order.
